2226-2499-2543.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-2543.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying its mana cost.
When Shivan Wurm enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4359-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5240-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2693-4693-4826-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
2693-4693-4826-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Overgrown Estate repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

348-789-1152-3191-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-789-1152-3191-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Gutter Grime triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

147-413-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

851-1722-2034-4893-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
851-1722-2034-4893-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5500-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

104-3490-4659-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4659-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1874-2919-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2919-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

147-780-5686.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

1062-2657-3484-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-2657-3484-5674.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
When the Bear enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

1127-1636.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
1127-1636.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

813-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
813-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Scholar of the Ages, adding {4}
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2558-5315-5687-5690.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

222-527-997-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-2417-4863.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Revolutionist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-4863.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2092-3456-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying at most {2}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
When Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate up to two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding up to {2}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3122-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative has a power of at least 2.
2713-3122-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Undercover Operative and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Undercover Operative from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Undercover Operative to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Undercover Operative enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Undercover Operative by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

955-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

12-128-3712-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
12-128-3712-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Elemental Bond and Garruk's Uprising's second ability trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1462-1671-2929.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1090-4050-4577.notablePrerequisites: At least four reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
1090-4050-4577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel, adding {1}.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, allowing you to remove four reprieve counters from it and return Restoration Angel from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, blinking Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

2034-2773-2906-2931.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
2034-2773-2906-2931.description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Faceless One, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Repeat.

57-1402-2178-4768.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1402-2178-4768.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Altar of the Brood triggers, milling each of your opponent for one.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

890-2713-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Palladium Myr.
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
890-2713-5200.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.
